decision.interpretation: A two-tier prompt path executes layers 0-5 on all prompt tokens, then maps every prompt token exactly once into 1,152 protected singleton or weighted summary states and passes only those states, original/final RoPE positions, compact causal order, representative late KV slots, and rebuilt attention metadata to layers 6-59. The conservative trace-bound result clears the locked target, but intentionally changes model semantics and carries no merge-quality claim.

limitations: No checkpoint was downloaded, no accelerator was claimed, and no provider was contacted.
The result is a source-complete offline physical proxy, not a GPU endpoint measurement.
The prompt bytes and hidden states are absent, so merge quality, protected-state overflow frequency, and fallback rate are unmeasured.
Prefill FP8-linear cost is measured in aggregate and apportioned by exact layer geometry; smaller-row kernel efficiency is conservatively bounded with a 10% non-scaling floor rather than measured.
The 15 ms scorer, weighted-summary construction, movement, graph, synchronization, metadata, and fragmentation envelope is analytical.

The candidate replaces the qualified route's 2,048-token dynamic prefill chunks with one 134,848-token exact-c32 prefill cohort; fit and the 3.5 ms synchronization/fragmentation reserve are analytical until target-GPU measurement.
The compact KV view deliberately does not free dropped stock slots, so allocator capacity and maximum concurrency do not improve; only later-layer KV writes and reads shrink.
No semantic, quality, convergence, deployability, or production-economic claim is made.

physical_accounting.evidence_type: measured scope-matched c32 H200 prefill attention and aggregate FP8 linear costs, exact c32 target-verification layer medians, exact work ratios, 10% non-scaling floors, and an analytical overhead envelope
physical_accounting.uncredited_savings: No ordinary autoregressive decode, local-attention decode, KV-write, normalization, activation, launch, scheduler, batching-capacity, or reduced allocator-pressure timing benefit is credited.

quality_recovery_path: Initialize the split runtime from the locked full-token teacher and train a layer-5 scorer plus boundary adapter with teacher hidden-state and logit distillation; retain the structural protection rules.
Continue training on 4K-to-32K text, retrieval, multi-turn tool traces, and formatting-heavy prompts while sweeping only budgets already inside the physical sensitivity envelope.
Require exact served-model GPQA-Diamond, TauBench, long-context retrieval, tool-call validity, formatting, multimodal regression, and full-token fallback calibration.
Only after quality recovery, run a matched exact-c32 H200 endpoint pair and replace the analytical floors and overhead envelope with measured profiler-off service time.

removed_execution.allocator_capacity_reason: Dropped stock slots remain owned until normal request cleanup because layers 0-5 retain their full-prompt KV; no concurrency credit is taken.

schedule.merge: Mandatory shared-prefix, recent, configured special, and tool-format positions remain singleton states. Every other input belongs to exactly one nonempty contiguous ordinal partition; layer-5 hidden RMS scores produce a softmax-weighted summary for that partition. Each summary uses its last contributor's position, and singleton/summary states are restored to strict causal order. Merge quality receives no credit.
schedule.overflow_behavior: Fail closed to the uncredited full-token route if protected positions leave fewer than 64 summary states or the full 4,214-token prefill is unavailable.
schedule.prefill_execution: CANDIDATE_RUNTIME_CONFIG.json coalesces the exact c32 prompt into one 134,848-token candidate prefill invocation so layer-5 scores cover each complete 4,214-token request before merging. Partial or mixed prompt chunks fail closed; no transfer from a partial-score path is claimed.
schedule.ragged_and_graph_behavior: The admitted c32 geometry uses a fixed 1,152-token late budget, so no late GEMM padding is retained and one late decode graph shape suffices. Variable or mixed budgets form separate cohorts or fall back.
schedule.state_semantics: A separate compact request-to-token view uses each singleton or summary state's final contributor slot for layers 6-59 while the allocator retains every original slot for layers 0-5 and safe request cleanup. Generated/verification slots append to the compact view on each call. Singleton original and summary-final positions define RoPE, group order preserves causality, and late attention metadata is rebuilt before layer 6.

sensitivity.interpretation: At the frozen 15 ms overhead, the 1,152-state schedule passes narrowly; larger summary budgets are reported explicitly. At 1,152 states, all incremental overhead must remain at or below the reported maximum. Protected-token overflow receives no assumed pass rate and falls back without credit.
